ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Using the diagram below, which organism is classified as a producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows an aquatic food web, labeling algae, blackfly, mayfly, stonefly, caddisfly, bully, trout, etc. algae is located at the bottom of the diagram and is drawn in the shape of a green plant; others such as blackfly, mayfly, stonefly, caddisfly, bully, and trout are all animals. Reasoning: The question asks which organism belongs to producer. Producers can make their own food, usually through photosynthesis. The one in the diagram that fits this characteristic is algae. Therefore the answer is algae.
